path.description: Path of the config; null when it can't be located (see Config file).

state.description: State of the config; missing also when it can't be located.

root.description: Root path named by the config, cleaned and with ~/ expanded (the same form as notes_path); null if the config is missing, unreadable, doesn't parse, or names a root in an illegal form.

root_exists.description: Whether the root path leads, through symlinks, to a directory.

metadata.description: State of ftask.json, per the three-step check (see File validity): corrupt fails step 1 or 3 (or is not a regular file); unsupported-format fails step 2.

schema.description: ftask.json's schema value; set whenever step 1 passes — whether metadata ends up ok, unsupported-format, or corrupt at step 3 — otherwise null.

last_id.description: Highest task ID issued; null unless metadata is ok.

tree.description: State of the configured root; null when config.root is null.

initialized.description: True unless the root is not initialized (see Root states). True, with tree null, when the config exists but is unusable.

usable.description: True when the root is usable (see Root states).

compatible.description: Whether tree.schema equals this binary's supported ftask.json version (see Format versions); null when tree.schema is null.
